title: Audit Intake Orchestrator: adaptive questionnaires & residency-aware evidence bundles
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers and compliance teams submit audit requests that require a mix of templated questionnaire responses, signed DPA clauses, residency/retention evidence, and exportable bundles. Currently this is manual and time-consuming for Redwood Support and slow for customers.

Goal: Build an Audit Intake Orchestrator that automates intake -> evidence collection -> export for audits. The orchestrator must: (1) surface pre-approved questionnaire templates and allow adaptive branching based on customer profile and product configuration; (2) match and attach signed DPA/DPA clause artifacts or surface required negotiation items; (3) produce residency-aware evidence bundles that include per-region data residency attestations, retention policy mappings, and redaction traces; (4) provide an admin UI and API for status, reviewer handoffs, and final bundle download; (5) emit an auditable activity trail and support secure export to customers and auditors.

Key requirements:
- Questionnaire templates with versioning and per-customer overrides.
- Adaptive branching logic (e.g., if customer uses Private deployment + EU region => include EU-specific residency questions).
- DPA clause registry: map contract clauses to canned responses and find matching signed artifacts in customer workspace.
- Evidence collector connectors: S3/GDrive/On-prem upload webhooks and automated retrieval from internal systems (logs, deployments, console snapshots).
- Residency evidence: capture region tags, custody metadata, and KMS roots for each artifact included.
- Retention mapping: expose current retention settings used by the customer, highlight deviations from requested retention in the audit, and include remediation checklist.
- Output: single downloadable archive (zip) with manifest.json, PDF summary, CSV index of artifacts, and signed hash chain for integrity.
- Access controls: RBAC for internal reviewers and signed pre-auth URLs for customers/auditors.
- Observability: per-request latency, failure modes, and SLA status on the orchestration pipeline.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not implement a full contract negotiation UI for DPA authoring. That will be a follow-up.
- This ticket will not change underlying retention enforcement; it only reports and maps settings.

Acceptance criteria:
- PM + Security sign-off on questionnaire template UI mockups and branching logic.
- Working API to start an audit intake, attach artifacts, and generate a downloadable bundle for a test customer.
- Residency metadata present in the generated bundle and visible in the admin UI.
- End-to-end smoke tests and an integration guide for Support and Solutions Engineering.
